rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Republic in exercise of the office of President
rows.text: The Presidency Library's transcript titles the address 'Discurso do Senhor Itamar Franco, Vice-Presidente da República, no exercício do cargo de Presidente da República, na cerimônia de posse ministerial, no Palácio do Planalto', dated Brasília, DF, 5 October 1992; in it he says that 'este Governo se inicia' in fulfilment of the Constitution.
